Row.Text: Herding cats. Farming rain. Teaching a goat to play the trombone. Organizing pirates. All of these are difficult. The vagabonds that attach themselves to the black flag come as they are: tattered, worn, broken…but with a drive for plunder.
Take all comers and make them know the Code – it is their greed, not their equipment, that the pirates need.
Turn the worst-off away. The Republic must have standards.
